title: TourMind 酒店预订连接配置
description: 连接您的 TourMind 个人账号。user_key 仅由 WorkBuddy 保存在本机，并在调用 TourMind MCP 时直接发送给 TourMind；不会提交到 WorkBuddy 云端，也不要在对话中粘贴。
description_en: Connect your personal TourMind account. WorkBuddy stores the user_key locally and sends it directly to TourMind only when calling the TourMind MCP. It is not uploaded to the WorkBuddy cloud and should never be pasted into a chat.
docLabel_en: Sign in and get a TourMind user_key

fields.label: TourMind user_key
fields.placeholder: 在 auth.journione.ai 验证邮箱并复制 uk_ 开头的 user_key
fields.placeholder_en: Verify your email at auth.journione.ai and copy the user_key beginning with uk_
fields.description: 用于预订、订单查询、取消和支付；请勿将其粘贴到对话、日志或截图中。
fields.description_en: Used for booking, order lookup, cancellation, and payment. Never paste it into chats, logs, or screenshots.
